data.name: Maskun
data.long_meaning: Maskun is a name of Prophet Idris (Enoch) in Arabic language. It is derived from the Arabic word 'maskana' which means 'to send' or 'to convey'. According to Islamic tradition, Prophet Idris was a messenger of Allah and a righteous man. He was given the knowledge of all things and was granted prophethood.
